name: Cabo San Lucas

routes.outcome: Official Catastro Los Cabos portal identified the Dirección de Catastro del Ayuntamiento de Los Cabos and advertised Cartografía en línea, Cartografía catastral, zones of value and municipal offices, including a Cabo San Lucas delegation.
Official cartography page described municipal cadastral cartography and urban coverage, but did not expose a verified anonymous parcel feature response in the indexed content.
Official information page described the municipal property register and cadastral information products; no public ID-plus-geometry API was evidenced.

Official municipal treasury page identifies the Dirección Municipal de Catastro and states duties to register, update and safeguard graphic, alphanumeric and cartographic cadastral information and cadastral keys. Unsafe owner, address, title and tax fields were not requested or retained.
Official municipal news reported CartoData as a digital tool used for cadastral and geographic information management; it did not publish an anonymous parcel endpoint.
Official municipal news documented current updates to cadastral cartography and value zones for Los Cabos, establishing current municipal cadastral activity but not open parcel geometry.

Browser-like curl with cookie jar, Accept and Accept-Language failed before an HTTP response because the host certificate was expired. No certificate exception was authorized; no retry with verification disabled was made.

Official predial consultation page loads, but its consultation requires a clave catastral and concerns fiscal account lookup, not a parcel geometry service. No key was submitted and no unsafe fields were requested.
National SEDATU dataset describes modernization program statistics, not an open Cabo San Lucas parcel geometry source; treated as general national agency context only.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: Official Catastro Los Cabos portal, cartography page, municipal information page, treasury cadastral duties, current municipal CartoData news and predial consultation page were inspected through indexed official content. Direct portal retrieval was blocked by expired TLS certificate.
schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: Official municipal material refers to claves catastrales and cadastral registration, but no parcel feature record was obtained to validate the native key structure.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID if exposed

qualification.reason: A local municipal cadastral custodian and active cartographic program are evidenced, but no anonymous parcel layer, native identity, CRS or bounded geometry response was obtained.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
No exact-point parcel query succeeded; this is not evidence of citywide absence.
No parcel polygons are retained because no safe native-identity geometry response was obtained.
The Dirección Municipal de Catastro del Ayuntamiento de Los Cabos is treated as the local cadastral custodian; SEDATU/datos.gob.mx is general national context, not a local parcel source.
The Catastro Los Cabos HTTPS certificate failure was not bypassed and no credentials, CAPTCHA, private token or login route was attempted.
The packet is complete as a research record, not source integration or runtime admission.
uncertainty: The current municipal cartography and CartoData tooling may contain parcel geometry, but the public service endpoint, access model, native parcel identity, field schema, CRS, anonymous query behavior and citywide completeness remain unresolved.
